points.name: Warder Stilgiss
points.note: Shadowforge City, east of centre; Verek fights with him.

points.name: Hurley Blackbreath
points.note: Grim Guzzler tavern, with Ribbly/Plugger/Phalanx events.

points.name: Golem Lord Argelmach

points.name: General Angerforge

points.name: The Seven

points.name: Princess Moira Bronzebeard

strategies.text: Mind-control/fear caster; keep a dispeller and interrupt Mind Blast.
Fighters come out one at a time with the last as a boss; keep everyone inside the arena and rest between waves.
Fire caster that burns the group; use fire protection or kill the adds quickly.
Spawns fire elementals as he fights; kill adds and keep the tank mobile.
Kill the seven spirits; do not pull them all at once.
Two phases: Moira heals him until she is down, kill her first if she joins.

notes: Most boss positions: OpenMap DungeonBosses (MIT, Blizzard journal data). Route is my own typical Detention Block -> Shadowforge clear; floor 1/2 assignments follow OpenMap. uiMapID 242 from AllTheThings, 243 inferred. Keys (Shadowforge Key, Key to the City) and quest items not placed. Coordinates come from OpenMap (MIT), AllTheThings or web guides only; spots those lack are null. NeedRoll (GPL-3.0) was used only to cross-check; no values were copied.
